phase: slice 1 (ISO BMFF MOV/MP4 muxer) in progress
next: slice 1 muxer; slice 2 export queue; slice 3 AV1 encode (rav1e, after the steward sync pins it); slice 4 timeline export glue (harness); slice 5 VC-3 (DNxHD/HR) encode

spec_basis: STU-VID-060 (14-studio-creative-suite.md:24658): 'Video export is a StudioExportRecipe and 14.13 owns the format writers.'

STU-VID-051 (24559): 'Codec implementation is NOT reimplemented natively; it is reached through a declared adapter with a typed capability descriptor stating which containers, codecs, bit depths, chroma subsamplings and colour transfer functions it can decode and encode' + 'An absent adapter yields a determinate MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE result naming the codec'; D23 enrichment allows Studio-owned Rust adapters behind the same contract.

STU-VID-062 (25272): 'each supported container declares which codecs, colour metadata, caption streams and timecode tracks it can carry, and that an unsupported combination is refused with a determinate result before encoding starts rather than failing partway.'

STU-VID-064 (25329): 'An export is submitted to a queue, runs without a foreground window, reports determinate progress, is cancellable, and produces a receipt naming the recipe, the source span, the output artifact and the outcome ... Batch export of several sequences or several recipes is one queue with per-item receipts, not a loop the caller drives.'
STU-IO-142 (21106): frame rate stored as ticks per frame against 254,016,000,000 ticks per second.
STU-IO-143 (21126): bitrate facet minimum/target/maximum, encoding mode; hard bounds declared per exporter.
STU-MOT-120 (28014): render queue item = (composition, render settings, one or more output modules).
notes.owner: 14.13 owns the format writers (STU-VID-060/STU-PRO-043); module map: reel = decode/encode media adapters -> muxer, encoders and export queue in hsk-studio-reel; timeline glue (pulse frames via composite + score mixdown) in hsk-studio-harness, which already holds the pulse/composite/render-cpu/reel edges. No new module edge.
